key_insight: BB-Net uses attention-based learning to predict the distance of Bivariate Bicycle quantum codes, turning a hard combinatorial search problem into a fast inference task.
engineering_relevance: This can dramatically speed up screening of candidate quantum error-correcting codes in ML-driven design pipelines, helping researchers find promising low-overhead qLDPC codes faster.
method: Built a dataset of BB codes with distance upper bounds from high-budget heuristic searches.
Trained an attention-based neural network (BB-Net) to predict code distance.
Compared prediction quality against heuristic search baselines and exact-distance subsets.
evidence_signal: BB-Net reached 96.39% accuracy on reference distances in the test set and 98.94% on a subset with certified exact distances, outperforming heuristics that used up to 10^4 times more runtime.
watch_item: Performance depends on the BB-code distribution and labeled upper-bound data, so generalization to other quantum code families or unseen regimes still needs validation.
